### Documento oficial (copiado por la tarea): https://techstars.com/techstars-eit-urban-mobility-founder-catalyst
Techstars x EIT Urban Mobility Founder Catalyst. 10-week hybrid pre-accelerator, based in Barcelona, Spain, combining in-person and virtual programming: weekly masterclasses, pitch coaching and mentor sessions (over 50% one-to-one), around 10 hours per week, rising to full-time during the in-person components.
No upfront costs for startups. Initial investment of €10,000 (cash grant). Upon acceptance, startups sign a SAFE with EIT Urban Mobility for €50,000: the €10,000 cash grant plus €40,000 representing the value of programme services. Startups that hit agreed post-programme milestones within 6 months receive an additional €50,000 (not guaranteed). The programme covers reasonable travel and accommodation for the in-person experiences.
2026 cohort: applications open June 29, 2026; applications close August 26, 2026; programme start September 28, 2026; Demo Day December 3, 2026. Up to 15 startups in Cohort 1 (2026); 45 startups across three cohorts over three years.
Eligibility: early-stage (pre-seed) for-profit startups in urban mobility; early traction, customer validation or strong founder insight; legally incorporated in an EU Member State or a Horizon Europe-associated third country; companies that previously took part in a Techstars Founder Catalyst, Techstars Accelerator or EIT Urban Mobility Accelerator are generally not eligible.
